explanation: Two heavy bodies (m~17.9 each, bodies 0 and 2) undergo a close encounter: distance 0.965 at step 5 shrinking to 0.481 at step 6, comparable to softening 0.3, so accelerations are very strong. With large dt=0.0311 the leapfrog substep controller uses only 6 substeps per outer step (steps 5 and 6) which is insufficient, so integration error injects energy: total energy rises from 17.4 at step 0 to 27.5 at step 5 to 102.9 at step 6, violating energy_conserved. Reducing dt to 0.005 removes the failure, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
